findings.statement: Initial angle increases and exit angle decreases with expansion ratio for each stated fractional length. Displayed curves start at area ratio 5 and extend to 50; lengths 60,70,80,90,100 percent.

Worked example gives theta_n=27.4 degrees and theta_e=9.8 degrees for epsilon=14 and length=80 percent; equivalent cone includes downstream throat rounding term R*(sec15-1), not only sharp-corner cone length. The source calls parabolic contour near-optimum approximation and recommends MOC for more accurate divergent-contour calculations.
